target.statement: SongSage (SFT) rewrites user queries for zero-shot playlist recommendation and reaches Recall@1 = 13.69% (R@5 = 26.72%, Emb-Sim = 88.92), beating GPT-4o's 11.45 / 23.25 / 60.52 on the PlaylistSense queries.
target.dataset: PlaylistSense (5,000 NetEase Music playlists, 10 queries each, Chinese) against a 300k 'Golden Descriptions' library

compute.basis: The paper gives no code/checkpoint/data URL; its own pipeline requires 5.48B-token continual pretraining of a 7B model on 16 A100 GPUs (Table 7: 7147 steps) plus a 300k golden-description pool, and even the inference-only path means running a 7B model over 5,000 playlists (20 lyrics each) plus retrieval on a CPU-only laptop, which is tens of hours.

blockers: LyricBank, LyricBank-SFT, the preference set and PlaylistSense are explicitly NOT released ('keep the datasets inaccessible due to copyright restrictions')
PlaylistSense/LyricBank are scraped from NetEase Music (2.5M songs, 200K playlists) - copyright-restricted, not downloadable
the 300k 'Golden Descriptions' retrieval library and the rewritten-query references are generated with DeepSeek (closed model) and are not published
no code, checkpoint or training-script links appear anywhere in the PDF despite the promise to 'release the SongSage and training script'
full reproduction requires continual pretraining 5.48B tokens on 16 A100 GPUs (2x8) plus LoRA SFT and DPO
data quality/instruction sets were built with LLM+human curation that cannot be replicated
title: SongSage: A Large Musical Language Model with Lyric Generative Pre-training
